decisions.reason: The trommel screen builds directly on the firm's existing screening and separation knowledge, and its incremental development from BASIC 518 to 518 FLEX signals successful assimilation and application of related know-how.
The flail shredders are closely related to the firm's established shredding competence, and the update to EU Stage V shows it can incorporate new regulatory knowledge effectively.
The mobile high-speed grinder leverages the firm's existing grinding and shredding capabilities, and its continued promotion indicates management can interpret early results as positive.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder is a core extension of the firm's stationary shredding line, with the CERON generation demonstrating strong absorptive capacity through use of proven components and setting new standards.
